preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000.
Each test case must have an integer N between 3 and 1000.
The sum of N over all test cases must not exceed 5000.

postconditions.description: The output array A must have a length equal to N.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= 10**18 for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: Each element of the array A must be between 1 and 10^18.

postconditions.expression: all(any(gcd(subsequence) == i for subsequence in subsequences) for i in range(1, N + 1))
postconditions.description: For each integer i from 1 to N, there must exist a subsequence of A with gcd equal to i.
